title: Alia Bhatt urges fans to support Assam flood relief; says “It happens every year and it still catches us off guard”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star shared an emotional note on Instagram, pledging to highlight relief initiatives as Assam continues to battle one of its worst flood crises.

Adding to this, In her note, Alia highlighted the scale of the humanitarian crisis, pointing out the loss of lives, widespread displacement, and the destruction faced by thousands of families. She also stressed the need for both immediate relief and long-term rehabilitation efforts. She wrote, “Right now, floods are affecting so many parts of our country with Assam being among the hardest hit, facing an incredibly challenging time. More than 60 lives have been lost. Lakhs of people have been displaced. Entire families have lost their homes, their land, their livestock... and for some, even the people they love. It happens every year and it still catches us off guard.”

Meanwhile, The star further opened up that she would be using her platform to share information about organizations involved in relief work on the ground and encouraged people to contribute in whatever way they could. The note also added, “Assam needs immediate relief right now, and it'll need support for the long road to recovery. If you've been wondering how you can help, I'll be sharing a few ways we can support relief efforts over the next few days, through organisations working on the ground. #CircleOfHope.”

Notably, Alia is among several celebrities who have spoken about the situation in Assam, with many taking to social media to amplify relief efforts and encourage donations. As rescue and rehabilitation operations continue, public figures have been using their platforms to draw attention to the needs of those affected by the disaster.

As per the latest buzz, Every year, seasonal flooding impacts large parts of Assam, leading to significant damage to homes, agricultural land, and public infrastructure. This year's floods have once again displaced lakhs of residents, prompting relief agencies and volunteers to intensify rescue and support operations across the state.

In further updates, On the professional front, Alia Bhatt was last seen in YRF's spy thriller Alpha , alongside Sharvari, Bobby Deol, and Anil Kapoor. She will next be seen in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War , co-starring Ranbir Kapoor and Vicky Kaushal. The movie is currently slated for a theatrical rollout in January 2027.

On top of that, With her latest appeal, Alia Bhatt has urged her followers to look beyond social media and contribute towards relief efforts, while emphasizing that communities affected by the Assam floods will require sustained support even after the immediate crisis subsides.

title: BTS May Be Headed For Its Biggest Year At The Grammys Yet
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights. Hugh McIntyre covers music, with a focus on the global charts. Follow Author Jul 23, 2026, 02:00pm EDT --:-- / --:-- This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . Summary BTS could have its biggest Grammy year yet at the 2027 ceremony thanks to Arirang, “Swim” and “Normal.” The group remains winless after five nominations, but the new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category may give the septet its clearest path to a first trophy as a performing act.

Adding to this, With two singles and an album eligible and a new category — Best Asian Pop Music Performance — seemingly made specifically for the band, BTS may soon win a Grammy. LOS ANGELES, CA - FEBRUARY 10: South Korean boy band BTS attends the 61st Annual GRAMMY Awards at Staples Center on February 10, 2019 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Steve Granitz/WireImage) WireImage K-pop became a major commercial force in the United States years ago, and its popularity continues to grow all the time. Grammy recognition has moved much more slowly, as most of the genre’s biggest singers and groups have yet to be acknowledged by the Recording Academy.

Meanwhile, Only a select few K-pop stars have collected nominations, including BTS and Blackpink singer Rosé, while the women behind Huntr/x from KPop Demon Hunters also competed at the 2026 ceremony. “Apt.” and “Golden” became the first songs by K-pop artists to be nominated for Song of the Year, with the former also making history in the hugely competitive Record of the Year field.

Notably, “Golden” became the first K-pop recording to win a Grammy only a few months back when its writers claimed Best Song Written for Visual Media honor. The prize went to the songwriters rather than the performers who comprise Huntr/x, meaning a K-pop musical act has still never won a Grammy as the named performer.

As per the latest buzz, That could change at the 2027 ceremony. The Recording Academy is introducing Best Asian Pop Music Performance, a category that recognizes K-pop, J-pop, C-pop and other pop recordings that meaningfully incorporate at least one Asian language. BTS will surely be considered one of the early favorites, but which song the septet submits could determine whether the outfit finally wins.

In further updates, BTS has received five Grammy nominations without winning any trophies. “Dynamite,” “Butter” and “My Universe,” the group’s collaboration with Coldplay, all competed for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance. “Yet to Come (The Most Beautiful Moment)” was nominated for Best Music Video. BTS was even included in Coldplay’s Album of the Year nomination for Music of the Spheres , which features “My Universe.”

On top of that, That last appearance technically brought BTS into the Grammys’ largest race, but none of the septet’s own albums has been nominated. Its 2026 project Arirang may change that, though Album of the Year is sure to be especially competitive this time around.

Arirang arrived this spring as BTS’s long-awaited comeback album. The collection gave the group another No. 1 in America, and it features several recordings that could be distributed throughout different Grammy fields.

title: Sadie Sink Is Chasing New Challenges
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

After Stranger Things wrapped, Sink took a break from TV and went to the stage, appearing on Broadway in John Proctor Is the Villain —for which she was nominated for a Tony Award—and in the West End in Romeo & Juliet , opposite Noah Jupe. She then joined the Spiderverse in a much-anticipated, still closely guarded role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. But the theater was her first home; Sink got her start in local and regional theater, which led her to a role on Broadway as another famous redhead: the one and only Annie. “My foundation as an star was rooted in the theater,” Sink shared. “Returning to it with John Proctor , the first play I’d done in 10 years, I was excited to rediscover the space as an adult.”

Adding to this, Sink noted that spending time with a character in the rehearsal room is one of her favorite parts of putting on a play. “You’re discovering new things, and it’s amazing to see where the performance started versus where it ends up,” she shared. “I became so much more comfortable onstage towards the end of the run [with John Proctor ], so when I was talking about doing Romeo & Juliet on the West End, that’s a much more demanding role, but I thought, ‘I think I’m ready for that.’”

Meanwhile, Photo: Getty Images John Proctor Is the Villain is now being made into a movie, and while Sink isn’t reprising her role as Shelby, she is playing the role of executive producer, introducing her to a completely new avenue of the entertainment industry. “You get more creative say, you’re taking it to studios, finding a home for it,” she explained of the new gig, adding that once she found out the play was going to Hollywood, she really wanted to “have a handprint” on the project in some way, given her familiarity with the material. “When you’re in it and focusing on a character, you have a really narrow view of things. When you step outside [of the character], it opens up the whole world. From being in the rehearsal room, I have a deep understanding of the play and the entire world, and how do we take that from one room on a stage and open it up for movie?" (Sink is also acting in and serving as executive producer on The Marriage Plot, a TV adaptation of the 2011 novel by Jeffrey Eugenides, for FX. )

Notably, As for future acting roles, Sink shared that she feels really privileged to be able to choose projects that align with where she is right now. “When you do find something that clicks, you just know . It’s a gut instinct, a story you want to tell,” she explained. “I look for something that is stretching and building new muscles and finding joy in it. It’s OK to do stuff because it’s fun. Because you can have challenging roles, but I want to leave room for having fun.”

As per the latest buzz, Her creative process in developing a character, whether it’s Juliet from Romeo & Juliet or the young woman in Taylor Swift’s “All Too Well” music video , really depends on the role. For example, Sink spent a year working on Shakespeare, learning how to translate Juliet’s words into her own voice. She’s also gotten more comfortable speaking up and building her own interpretation of a character. “When I was younger, I’d have ideas but wouldn’t share them," Sink told the Teen Vogue Fest crowd. “I was shy and wouldn’t recognize my potential. Now I know my instincts have value and I should follow them.”

In further updates, Photo: Getty Images Entering the Marvel Universe is a very big deal for any young star, and though Sink’s Spider-Man role is shrouded in secrecy, she did share that she was “super excited” to become part of the Spiderverse. It also felt like the flipside of her work on Stranger Things; this time, she was the newbie on set. “You don’t always know what to expect when you’re stepping into such a big franchise… [with] people who have been playing those characters for ten years, which was like Stranger Things,” she shared. But everyone was “so warm, lovely, and relaxed,” which helped her settle into her (still-as-yet-unannounced) character. (Don’t worry, there’s not long to wait! Brand New Day comes out July 31.)

On top of that, Sink shared she feels “really fortunate” that the thing she wanted to do as a child—acting!—is still the thing she loves and feels like she’s meant to do today. “I never really reached a point where I was like, ‘Do I want to continue acting?’ I always knew,” she shared. But she still feels like she has a lot to learn. “That takes time and experience, and putting yourself in challenging situations that will grow your skill set. I feel like chasing challenges is what really helped me feel more confident in what I’m doing.”

title: Wesneski to make first MLB start in nearly 15 months: 'I don’t know how to act'
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:
Wesneski to make first MLB start in nearly 15 months: 'I don’t know how to act' 2:24 AM UTC Brian McTaggart

Adding to this, ANAHEIM -- More pitching help is on the way for the Astros, with right-hander Hayden Wesneski slated to be reinstated from the injured list and start Wednesday’s series finale against the Angels at Angel Stadium.

Meanwhile, Wesenski, one of three players the Astros acquired in December 2024 from the Cubs in the Kyle Tucker trade, will be pitching in a Major League game for the first time since May 6, 2025. He was in the Houston rotation to begin last year and was 1-3 with a 4.50 ERA in 32 innings before getting injured.

Notably, “I’m going to be nervous,” he shared. “I’m excited about it. I don’t know how to act tomorrow, to be honest with you. The first time I threw off the mound in the FCL [Florida Complex League], it was big time. Tomorrow, I can’t tell you how I’ll act, but I’ll figure it out.”

As per the latest buzz, Wesneski, a Houston native who was 9-13 with a 3.93 ERA in 190 innings in three seasons with the Cubs, is the second Astros pitcher to return from Tommy John surgery this month. Right-hander Ronel Blanco returned July 20 and has made two starts, posting an 8.10 ERA. In fact, Blanco and Wesneski both had Tommy John surgery within a couple weeks of each other and pushed each other through the recovery.

In further updates, “Certain times were fine and certain times it wasn’t,” Wesneski shared. “It had ebbs and flows. The first eight weeks with the brace weren’t great, but having Ronel Blanco next to me really did help a lot. He’s a great person and he helped push me and keep me motivated. There were times in Florida [during rehab] it was getting a little dull and boring, but we worked through it. Obviously, I’m very excited for tomorrow.”

On top of that, Wesneski posted a 2.25 ERA in five Minor League rehab starts, striking out 21 batters in 20 innings. In his final rehab start Friday at Triple-A Sugar Land, he struck out seven batters, throwing 80 pitches, 49 for strikes, while topping out at 95.9 mph.

“The stuff has felt good,” he shared. “There are times it felt inconsistent, but for the most part I’ve thrown a lot of strikes, which is the biggest deal. I’m spinning it well. There’s little inconsistencies here and there, but having five starts and the amount of strikes I’ve thrown, for the most part I’ve commanded the ball pretty well.”

Wednesday, July 29, 2026 2:04AM A biker performed a wheelie as a driver in a Mercedes-Benz was leading police on a chase through L.A. LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- A driver in a as per reports stolen SUV on Tuesday afternoon led Los Angeles police on a high-speed chase that was marked by several dangerous encounters, including a close call involving multiple motocross bike riders on the 110 Freeway.

Adding to this, Shortly before 6 p.m., the suspect was using the right shoulder of the southbound 405 Freeway to pass other motorists near Culver Boulevard as multiple LAPD cruisers followed the white Mercedes-Benz.
Meanwhile, The driver exited the freeway and the dangerous pursuit continued on surface streets in the Del Rey area.
Notably, Initial reports indicated the SUV was may have been stolen in the Laguna Beach area, and that the suspect was possibly armed with a handgun.

As per the latest buzz, By 6:15 p.m., the suspect was speeding eastbound on Slauson Avenue in the Hyde Park area, weaving in and out of traffic, running red lights and at times moving into empty oncoming lanes.
In further updates, About five minutes later, in one of the chase's most harrowing moments, the driver encountered nearly a dozen dirt bike riders as the SUV entered the the northbound 110 Freeway.
On top of that, The suspect merged onto the freeway while being passed closely by the motorcyclists, some of whom were popping wheelies with their front wheel in the air.
Just before 6:30 p.m., the driver exited the freeway and entered a downtown L.A. parking structure at the intersection of Hill and Eighth streets.

title: Shobhaa De calls Salman Khan’s ‘it’s done bro’ post for Sonam Wangchuk cringe: ‘He thought he was being cool’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Author and columnist Shobhaa De has taken a swipe at Bollywood's response to the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)-led protests, questioning whether the industry's stars are still in tune with India's Gen Z. She also mocked Salman Khan 's social media post for activist Sonam Wangchuk , dismissing it as “cringe.”

Adding to this, Salman Khan was one of the first big Bollywood celebrities to voice his support for the CJP-led protests over the alleged NEET-UG paper leak. Shobhaa De slams Salman Khan Shobhaa De called out Bollywood's response to the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)-led protests, saying the industry's biggest stars seemed disconnected from Gen Z and failed to grasp the sentiment behind a youth-led movement. She expressed her views in her piece published in ThePrint.

Meanwhile, In her criticism, Shobhaa De took particular aim at Salman Khan's social media message for activist Sonam Wangchuk and also called out comments by Kangana Ranau t, Hema Malini and Anupam Kher during the ongoing youth-led movement. She described Bollywood’s response as “uncool” and “irrelevant”.

Notably, Talking about Salman’s post, Shobhaa wrote, “Ditto with Salman Khan. Calling Sonam Wangchuk ‘Bro’ and offering him a home-cooked meal from the Khan kitchen to break his fast attracted widespread derision, not praise… Maybe Salman thought he was being ‘cool’. But Gen Z rewrote the definition of ‘cool’. And this cringe message was anything but.”

As per the latest buzz, She shared Salman was not the only star who seemed out of sync with young Indians, arguing that several movie stars chose to speak up only after they felt it was politically safe to do so.

In further updates, Shobhaa wrote, “Bollywood has never looked this ‘uncool’. This irrelevant. Especially those stars who jumped in with inane ChatGPT-scripted posts once they had apparently received the green signal from their political patrons. The very stars whose box-office fortunes depend on Young India suddenly woke up, only to be met with mockery. Senior Aunty and Uncle stars such as Hema Malini and Anupam Kher added insult to injury, while Kangana Ranaut—just this side of ‘Aunty’ status—lost the few Gen Z followers she still possessed with her tasteless remarks. I call them ‘Generation Gutter’... The thing to understand is this: Gen Z does not need star endorsements or heroes. It’s the reverse. Celebrities need Gen Z. This is a generation that marches, sings and dances to its own unique beat.”
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Salman Khan (@beingsalmankhan)

Superstar Salman Khan was one of the first big Bollywood celebrities to voice his support for the CJP-led protests over the alleged NEET-UG paper leak. Earlier this month, he posted on Instagram to share a note backing the students participating in the CJP protest after it turned violent following a police lathi charge. He wrote, “It was such a peaceful movement, feel so sad that it had to take a violent turn. My heart goes out to the students and their families who were hurt. Paper leak is a very serious issue, and I am glad to know n see that the kids of our country have come together for a better educational system, and their parents supported them.”

title: ‘You beat kids, tear-gassed them’: Vishal Dadlani defends Gen-Z protesters amid Kangana Ranaut's remarks
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Music composer and singer Vishal Dadlani has come out in favour of Gen-Z student protesters who have been criticised for the choice of words in their speeches and social media handles. In response to the criticism coming in the wake of Kangana Ranaut 's Instagram meltdown in the last few days, Vishal has shared that while the attention should be drawn towards the way in which the protesters were treated, especially being lathi-charged, tear-gassed and beaten up.

Adding to this, Vishal Dadlani reacts to Gen Z protest row: ‘Bad language? You beat kids’ What Vishal Dadlani shared Taking to Instagram on Monday, Vishal Dadlani shared a strongly-worded note defending the students. He wrote, "Bad Language!? You beat kids in the street. Pelted rocks at them, and blamed them! SHOT at them. Tear-gassed them. Pellet-gunned their fkn faces. YOUR bhaade-ke-goons are going around threatening and beating them even now! You collected the gaalis, my "fraand"."

Meanwhile, In the caption of his post, Vishal also took aim at what he described as organised attempts to shape public opinion against the young protesters. He wrote, “Oh, and….Running paid story-campaigns and influencer campaigns only makes you look more pathetic,” followed by a laughing emoji.

Notably, View this post on Instagram Kangana Ranaut criticised the protesters Vishal Dadlani's reaction was immediate following the backlash faced by BJP Member of Parliament and star Kangana Ranaut after she called out the students' protestors because of the manner in which they had behaved and the videos that they were sharing online. On her Instagram stories, she referred to the videos as “puke-inducing.”

As per the latest buzz, She wrote, “Never in my life have I seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing. The way they speak and the kind of language they are using... never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once.”

In further updates, Kangana further added, “India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication. You call yourself cockroaches and look/behave like them as well. There is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels. I need some healing, digital detox.”

On top of that, She also wrote, "I call them Generation Gutter. Some of them have nothing to offer to the system. They are not good at studies. They are so ugly and corrupt that they can't even be homemakers," she added.

Since then, Kangana Ranaut has been facing backlash across social media platforms for using disrespectful words for the youth of the nation whilst never fully calling out how the protestors were treated at Jantar Mantar on July 20 during Sansad March, organised by Cockroach Janata Party (CJP).

title: Alia Bhatt voices concern over Assam floods, urges fans to support relief efforts: ‘It happens every year’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Alia Bhatt has lent her voice to the growing concern over the devastating floods in Assam . Deeply disturbed by the situation, the star took to social media to express solidarity with those affected and urged her followers to support ongoing relief efforts. The star lamented that despite the floods occurring every year, the nature of the crisis “still catches us off guard”.

Adding to this, Alia Bhatt was last seen in the spy thriller Alpha, co-starring Sharvari, Bobby Deol and Anil Kapoor. Alia Bhatt makes an appeal On Tuesday, Alia posted on Instagram Stories to voice concern over the devastating floods in Assam, calling for immediate relief efforts. She also appealed to her followers to step forward and extend support to those affected during the crisis.
Meanwhile, “Right now, floods are affecting so many parts of our country with Assam being among the hardest hit, facing an incredibly challenging time,” Alia wrote in the note posted on her Stories.

Notably, Alia continued, “More than 60 lives have been lost. Lakhs of people have been displaced. Entire families have lost their homes, their land, their livestock... and for some, even the people they love. It happens every year and it still catches us off guard.”

As per the latest buzz, “Assam needs immediate relief right now, and it'll need support for the long road to recovery. If you've been wondering how you can help, I'll be sharing a few ways we can support relief efforts over the next few days, through organisations working on the ground,” she wrote while ending the note with hashtag, “#CircleOfHope”.

In further updates, Besides Alia, star Bhumi Pednekar has also been using her platform to raise awareness about the flood crisis in Assam. She also urged people to support relief efforts in flood-hit Assam while recalling the cumulative relief efforts in Punjab last year. She shared videos on her Instagram handle to highlight flood-affected Assam, which include the displacement of several villages, an increasing death toll and others.

On top of that, Assam witnesses floods almost every year during monsoon and this time too, 25 of the state’s 35 districts have been impacted. Until Saturday 66 persons had died across the state due to floods-- 48 were from Sibsagar and Charaideo. Nearly 400 villages and around 500,000 people (of the 654,000 affected in total) of the two districts are still affected and close to 15,000 have taken shelter in relief camps.

On Saturday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi sought an update from Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on the relief and rescue operations that continues across the flood-hit districts. “He sought an update on the extent of the devastation, the ongoing relief operations and the challenges we are confronting on the ground. I briefed him on the measures being undertaken by the State Government and our efforts to reach out to every affected family,” Sarma wrote on X. The Indian Army and the Indian Air Force (IAF) are also assisting the state government in its relief operations.

title: Salman Khan steps up as devastating floods hit lakhs of people in Assam; plans food and rebuilding support: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood superstar Salman Khan has done his bit quietly to aid those who have been affected by the flood disaster in Assam. It is being reported that the star has come together with one of his fan clubs in the region to launch a phased relief operation under his NGO, Being Human. This will start with food distribution followed by supply of other basic necessities.

Adding to this, Amid Assam flood crisis, Salman Khan starts relief mission with Being Human and fan club. (PTI) What is Salman Khan helping with? As per the report published in India Today, a source close to the star disclosed that the relief operation has been meticulously planned phase wise. The first phase has already kicked off through the distribution of ready-to-eat food packets and other essentials in the flooded areas.

Meanwhile, In the next few weeks, the campaign is likely to include rations, kits, and rebuilding efforts at schools and hospitals. In addition to food, they also plan to distribute medicines, drinking water, sanitary napkins, and mosquito repellent spray among others to people hit by the floods.

Notably, While many celebrities such as Bhumi Pednekar and Adil Hussain have taken to the social media platform to spread awareness about the situation, Salman is one of the few from the Bollywood fraternity who has launched the ground level relief effort there.

As per the latest buzz, There has been wide destruction due to flooding in the state of Assam with lakhs of people being affected in different districts of the state. Over 600 villages have been inundated; there has been significant damage to property and lives of citizens while the casualty count has risen to 68, as reported by Hindustan Times .

In further updates, But on Tuesday, authorities claimed that there are some positive signs in the situation as the number of affected people has reduced to 4.45 lakh with the rise in the water levels in many districts. According to Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA), the total number of people affected in Sivasagar, Golaghat, Charaideo, Jorhat, Nagaon, and Kamrup Metropolitan districts is 4,45,495. Till Sunday, the number was above 5 lakh.

On top of that, The ASDMA figures for Monday evening opened up that a total of 631 villages in 21 revenue circles were still flooded. The worst-hit district is Charaideo with the total number of affected people standing at 1.88 lakh, followed by Sivasagar with 1.44 lakh people affected.

The floods have had an adverse effect on agriculture and livestock in the state. As many as 37,139 hectares of cultivated lands are under water, while more than 2.56 lakh animals are affected. More than 26,000 animals are reported to have been swept away. The disaster has also caused damage to the roads in some of the affected districts like Jorhat, Sivasagar, and Charaideo.

title: The Frying Pan: Mariners at Dodgers Series Preview
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

Link NEW YORK, NEW YORK - JULY 24: Max Muncy #13, Shohei Ohtani #17 and Mookie Betts #50 of the Los Angeles Dodgers celebrate after defeating the New York Mets at Citi Field on July 24, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Jim McIsaac/Getty Images) Getty Images That series in Arlington wasn’t a complete disaster thanks to that come-from-behind victory on Sunday, but the Mariners were pretty thoroughly outplayed by the Rangers over the last four games. That puts Seattle in a really tough position. The team clearly isn’t good enough as constructed — they’re also supposedly a buyer ahead of the trade deadline too — but it feels like the issues on the roster are deep enough that pasting over a few acquisitions this week won’t solve the underlying problems (namely, massive underperformance from Cal and Julio). Anyway, the M’s will be making big decisions about the rest of their season while playing a three-game set against the Dodgers in Los Angeles. Good luck.

Adding to this, The Dodgers are well on their way towards becoming the first team since the 1998-2000 New York Yankees to win three championships in a row. They’ve got the best record in baseball, a 12.5 game lead in the NL West, and are essentially in cruise control until they reach the playoffs. They’ve dealt with their fair share of injuries this year — Blake Snell, Tyler Glasnow, Edwin Díaz, and Will Smith are all currently on the IL and a knee injury is preventing Shohei Ohtani from pitching at the moment — but the depth on this roster has reduced the impact from all those issues. This team is truly the best in baseball.

Meanwhile, While the impact from Ohtani’s knee injury has been focused on his work on the mound, it’s possible the injury has been affecting him at the plate somewhat. He injured the knee on June 11; since then he’s produced a merely human 107 wRC+. The Dodgers have two other former MVPs in their lineup and they’re aging in very divergent ways. Freddy Freeman is in the midst of another fantastic season (140 wRC+) while Mookie Betts has really struggled for the second consecutive season (90 wRC+). Los Angeles also hasn’t gotten much from Kyle Tucker, a huge offseason acquisition; he’s limped to a 99 wRC+ in what has been the worst season of his career. Despite uncharacteristically poor production from two of their superstars, Max Muncy (133 wRC+), Andy Pages (115 wRC+), and Tommy Edman (153 wRC+) have picked up a lot of the slack.

Notably, Justin Wrobleski has been one of the unsung heroes of the Dodgers pitching staff. Surrounded by big name pitchers, he’s posted the second lowest ERA and FIP among the starters on Los Angeles’ roster — better than Yoshinobu Yamamoto, Tyler Glasnow, Roki Sasaki, and Blake Snell. Wrobleski isn’t overpowering opposing batters, running one of the lowest strikeout rates among qualified starters. He doesn’t walk many either, which helps his strikeout-to-walk ratio look really good. The key to his success is inducing a ton of weak fly ball contact. That’s suppressed his BABIP and he’s been lucky enough to keep all that elevated contact inside the park. His 4.14 xFIP is nearly two runs higher than his ERA and a run higher than his FIP.

As per the latest buzz, Eric Lauer enjoyed a nice bounce back season in Toronto last year after spending all of 2024 in Korea. He couldn’t keep up the improvements and he was traded to the Dodgers in May. His ERA has come down in Los Angeles, but his peripherals are still pretty rough and his limited success can probably be chalked up to the greatly improved team context he’s pitching in now. The biggest problem for him is the total collapse of his strikeout rate; it’s dropped nearly nine points and it’s currently at a career-low. Both of his breaking balls have seen their whiff rates drop dangerously low. Without those pitches earning swings and misses, he doesn’t have any other weapons to keep batters from pounding his fastball.

In further updates, Roki Sasaki’s introduction to the major leagues has been pretty rough. A shoulder injury interrupted his adjustment period last year, though he did return late in the season to play a critical role out of the Dodgers bullpen. This year, he’s tweaked his pitch mix to reintroduce a hard splitter to give him two different offspeed pitches to attack batters with. His command is still pretty spotty and his fastball hasn’t given him much of a foundation to work off of. Still, he’s shown spurts of promise with his expanded repertoire and honed mechanics. He may be working through his development process in the big leagues, but he’s shown a lot of resilience in the face of high expectations and tons of failure.

On top of that, The Mariners slipped to third place in the division after the Astros won the first game of their series against the Angels yesterday. Los Angeles was leading 4-2 in the ninth, but allowed four runs on one hit in the top of the ninth to blow the game. After beating up on the Mariners, the Rangers will head to Tampa Bay to face the best team in the AL. Over in the Wild Card race, the Guardians play in Cincinnati this week while the Twins host the Royals.
The Mariners try to right the ship after a tough loss last night against the Rangers

title: Two eclipses are taking place in August. Here’s where you can view them.
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

August is when the night sky really gets interesting. The Perseids, the best meteor shower of the year, continue to grow in intensity and peak on the night of Aug. 12, and this time the moon actually cooperates: it’s new that same day, so skies will be dark enough to catch the show in full.

Adding to this, “It’s predicted to have between 50 and 100 of these shooting stars per hour,” shared Francine Jackson, staff astronomer at the Ladd Observatory at Brown University. “Many watch this one more than any other because it’s easy to lie on the grass, or on a chaise lounge, without worrying about dressing up like for an Arctic expedition.”

Meanwhile, Aug. 12 is also the date of a total solar eclipse, though not for us much in North America. The path of totality sweeps through the Arctic, Greenland, Iceland, and into northern Spain — the first total solar eclipse visible from mainland Europe in 27 years. Amazingly, the last one for mainland Europe was on Aug. 11, 1999.
Notably, Unfortunately, from New England, we’ll only catch a partial eclipse, if anything at all.

As per the latest buzz, “The solar eclipse here in Southern New England will be about 14 percent, beginning about 1:02 p.m. (EDT),” Jackson shared. She cautioned that “this cannot be observed with the naked eye. You must have eye protection to view it.”

In further updates, But hang on, because we do have an eclipse of our own late in August — the deep partial lunar eclipse. On the night of Aug. 27 into early Aug. 28, 96 percent of the moon’s face will slide into Earth’s shadow enough that the moon should take on that reddish “blood moon” glow at its peak, just after midnight.

On top of that, Jackson shared it’ll almost “seem as if the moon has a ‘polar cap.’ It will begin to enter the Earth’s major shadow, the umbra, at 10:33 p.m., with the most coverage at 12:12 a.m. before the moon leaves the umbra at 1:52 a.m.”

That’s also the same night as the Sturgeon Moon, August’s full moon, which peaks at 12:18 a.m. ET. Obviously, we won’t know the weather for quite a while, but hopefully it cooperates so we get a chance to see this wonder of nature.

Adding to this, Sauer also asked the court to issue an immediate administrative stay – an order that temporarily puts the lower court’s order on hold while the justices consider the government’s request.

Meanwhile, Trump signed the executive order at the center of the case, titled “Ensuring Citizenship Verification and Integrity in Federal Elections” on March 31 of this year. Among other things, the order instructs the U.S. Postal Service to propose rules for mail-in and absentee ballots, and it directs the Department of Homeland Security to compile “state citizenship lists” – lists of individuals in each state who are U.S. citizens over the age of 18. Under the order, the rules issued by the USPS must provide that the Postal Service can only send mail-in ballots to voters whose names appear on the state citizenship lists.

Notably, A group of 23 states and the District of Columbia, led by California, went to federal court in Massachusetts to challenge the implementation of the order. They argued that the order conflicts with provisions in the Constitution that give states the power to determine voter eligibility and to set the “Times, Places, and Manner” of holding congressional elections.

As per the latest buzz, U.S. District Judge Indira Talwani agreed and on June 25 issued an order that prohibited the federal government from implementing the mail-in ballot and state citizenship list provisions for the Nov. 3, 2026, elections in the states that had filed the lawsuit.

In further updates, In an order issued on Saturday, a divided panel of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 1st Circuit turned down the government’s request to intervene. If the order were “to take effect for the elections taking place” in the fall, the majority wrote, “it would sow confusion and threaten disenfranchisement of many eligible voters.”

On top of that, The Trump administration then came to the Supreme Court on Monday, asking the justices to step in. Sauer argued that the courts should not yet consider the states’ lawsuit because the agencies haven’t yet decided how they will implement the order. But even if it were appropriate for courts to consider their request, Sauer continued, Talwani’s ruling should be put on hold to avoid “serious irreparable harm.” “Even if the agencies’ implementation plans end up being entirely lawful,” Sauer wrote, “there is not enough time to obtain ordinary appellate relief from the injunction in order to carry them out before the November election, especially given that any such plans will need to be implemented well before November given the timing of election procedures concerning voter-roll verification and mail voting.”
The court instructed the states to file a response to the government’s request by 4 p.m. EDT on Monday, Aug. 3.

title: The Greatest Supernatural Spin-Off of All Time Is Officially Streaming for Free
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

It was early on in Buffy the Vampire Slayer that the character Angel ( David Boreanaz ), the enigmatic love interest to Buffy Summers ( Sarah Michelle Gellar ), was actually a vampire who was cursed with immortality and seeking redemption. Although Angel became an ally to Buffy over the course of the first three seasons, it quickly became clear that the “will they or won’t they” dynamic was holding both characters back. It was at the same time that Buffy and her friends went off to college in Season 4 that the first season of Angel relocated to Los Angeles , where Angel starts his own detective agency helping fend off supernatural threats. Angel may have begun as a slightly darker, neo-noir version of the “monster of the week” series that Buffy the Vampire Slayer had originated as, but it steadily became a more ambiguous and demanding show about the complications of morality. Buffy the Vampire Slayer struggled to reach the same degree of excellence that it had attained in its first three seasons, but Angel got more compelling and interesting as it went along.

Adding to this, Angel benefits from containing a more complicated set of protagonists who had matured since their time on Buffy the Vampire Slayer . Cordelia Chase ( Charisma Carpenter ) began her time on Buffy the Vampire Slayer as a vain, self-absorbed teenager with a grudge against Buffy, but Angel turns her into a deeply empathetic, intelligent ally to Angel whose strength is seeing the good in people. Similarly, Wesley Wyndam-Pryce ( Alexis Denisof ) was introduced in the third season of Buffy the Vampire Slayer as an immature, inexperienced member of the Watchers, and Angel shows his growth into a leader who sees the importance of sacrificing personal pleasures for the sake of retaining balance. The biggest shift in Angel came in the characterization of the titular hero , as Angel himself grows beyond the somewhat humorless, detached anti-hero he was in Buffy the Vampire Slayer . Although Angel begins the series with the express goal of doing good, he steadily realizes that no amount of lives saved will make up for the lifetime of atrocities he committed as the soulless vampire “Angelus.”
Meanwhile, Your instincts, your strengths, and your particular way of thinking under pressure point to one villain you actually have a fighting chance against. Everyone else — good luck.
Notably, Jason is relentless, but he is also predictable — and that is the gap you would exploit.
As per the latest buzz, Michael watches before he moves. He is patient, methodical, and almost impossible to detect — until it's too late for anyone who isn't paying close enough attention.
In further updates, Pennywise is ancient, shapeshifting, and feeds on terror — but it has one critical vulnerability: it cannot function against someone who genuinely stops being afraid of it.
On top of that, Chucky's greatest advantage is that nobody takes him seriously until it's already too late. He exploits the gap between how something looks and what it actually is.

Angel is a step up from Buffy the Vampire Slayer in terms of filmmaking artistry because the flashback scenes add greater depth and offer a complete timeline of the different lives Angel has lived. Showing how his past comes to haunt him is critical in making the redemption arc compelling, especially since Angel has to constantly wrestle with his own dark side. The most profound idea in the entire series is established in Season 2, in which Angel realizes that evil can never be truly vanquished, and that there might not be a way to prevent hell on Earth . It’s a radical maturation from the “good versus evil” mentality in most genre stories, but it's not entirely cynical; the fact that Angel and his allies realize that their fight is never-ending makes the sacrifices they make more resonant.

title: Patience or Panic: Kyle Manzardo, Kyle Stowers, Jorge Soler
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:
Welcome to Week 18 of our Patience or Panic series!

Adding to this, Last season, it seemed like the Cleveland Guardians got Kyle Manzardo in a sweetheart deal. The Guardians acquired Manzardo from the Tampa Bay Rays in 2023 straight-up for Aaron Civale . Civale was shipped off to the Brewers in July of 2024 after a disastrous stint in Tampa Bay. Manzardo, on the other hand, raked. He posted a .945 OPS with 20 home runs in Triple-A in 2024 and was set for a regular MLB role in 2025.

Meanwhile, That 2025 role came for Manzardo and saw a superb return: A .234/.313/.455 slash, 27 home runs, 19 doubles, 70 RBIs, a .768 OPS and 113 wRC+. The then-24-year-old solidified himself as Cleveland’s long-term answer at first with plenty of upside still ahead of him. He had power to grow into, bat-to-ball abilities to find, and a BB% to be proud of. Cleveland’s shot call worked in spades.

Notably, At least it did then. 2026 has seen little return on Cleveland’s initial investment. Through 95 games, Manzardo’s hit .209/.298/.358 with just 11 home runs, 32 RBIs, a .656 OPS, and an 88 wRC+. Somehow, those numbers seem great in comparison to Manzardo’s last month of play. Over his last 22 games, he’s hitting .134/.205/.254 with a .459 OPS . In fact, Manzardo’s .429 July OPS is second-worst in all of baseball , trailing only Colt Emerson ’s .373 mark. He’s nobody’s sweetheart right now. The why is understandable. The how? Not so much.

As per the latest buzz, Finding that how demands a concession. Manzardo is, as he’s always been, a power-first kind of hitter. He hit well in the minors, yes, but his .544 slug over four seasons was the attraction. As was his 27 home runs a season ago. He’ll never hit for great average. He needn’t. So long as he’s driving the ball far and deep, and doesn’t need to happen at elite rates. Because if Manzardo is going to recapture Cleveland’s hearts, it’s going to be through longballs and barrels.

In further updates, Sadly, Manzardo isn’t having much luck in that department. His HR% has dropped from 5.1% to 3.3% in 2026. He’s not doing the first. Nor is he doing the second, with a Barrel% in similar decline. Nor is he checking out in other areas. Manzardo ranks 125th out of 147 qualified hitters this season in slugging percentage . In ISO, he ranks 97th . While an improvement, it still has him nearly in the back third of all players. Instead of going deep, he’s striking out, seeing his K% rise from 25.4% to 31.7 %. The latter now ranks Manzardo in the seventh percentile of all players.

On top of that, There’s not one cause at work here. Manzardo’s struck out 52 times on fastballs, 37 times on breaking balls, and 16 times on offspeed. Like a lothario, he’s susceptible to everything. And while he can console himself with a .261 average on all fastballs, he can’t in other departments. Against breakers, he’s hitting .159. Against offspeed pitches, he’s hitting .132. This is where average does matter, even for a guy like Manzardo. See, he can survive a .234 average so long as he’s making just enough contact. But when he’s hardly making any at all on anything?

In particular, he’s being torn apart by sliders and changeups. Manzardo is one of the worst hitters against the former. His .122 average is seventh-worst in baseball , his 48.8 Whiff% is sixth , and his 41.7 K% is 13th . He’s near defenseless. While he fares a little better against changeups, hitting .135, he has no juice against them, with a .135 slug. Manzardo, in comparison, is at least touting a .268 slug on all sliders. He can do something to them. He can’t do and hasn’t done anything against changeups.

title: No Shortcuts– From Qualifiers to the Main Draw: Martin Damm Jr.’s Next Step Arrives in Washington D.C.
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

At 22 years old, American Martin Damm Jr. is becoming one of the tour’s emerging talents. At the Mubadala DC Open, Damm played his way into the main draw, winning two qualifying matches. Damm first defeated Belgium’s Kimmer Coppejans in an easy 6-2, 6-0 match and then topped Jordanian Abdellah Shelbayh in a tightly contested three-set match. Damm shows us once again that he has the skills to get himself into the main draw and compete at the next level.

Adding to this, Washington isn’t just one stop on the 2026 calendar. It’s one that can set the stage for the summer. The DC Open begins the North American hard-court season before ATP Masters 1000 events in Canada and Cincinnati, culminating in the coveted US Open. With a notable reduction in the men’s draw this year–going from 48 to 32 players this year–getting into the main draw at this ATP 500 event is a big feat in itself.

Meanwhile, Damm’s second qualifying match against Shelbayh proved to be a battle of consistency. After losing the first set 4-6, Damm channeled his strong left-handed serve and focused on extending rallies under pressure. In the end, he won the second set 7-5 and won the deciding match tiebreak based on his composure. During the tiebreak, after Damm snagged a point to make it 3-2, Shelbayh double faulted, generating a significant momentum shift. The Washington crowd took to Damm’s side, showing Damm what it’s like to be an American playing in the nation’s capital.

Notably, “I think it’s 50-50 in tiebreaks,” Damm shared. “Sometimes you just lose your way…I thought I served well. Fortunately I had some good return points, and I was glad I was able to win it on the return and didn’t have to serve it out.”

As per the latest buzz, Damm’s 2026 season so far has been one of promise and opportunity. Just this February, Damm advanced to his first ATP semifinal at the ATP 250 event in Montpellier, France. Damm, once again, worked his way through qualifying and then delivered an impressive upset against former World No. 6 Hubert Hurkacz.

In further updates, Damm is one of a few men’s players at the DC Open with a decorated tennis parent–it’s not just Ben Shelton and Cruz Hewitt. Martin Damm (senior) became one of the world’s top doubles specialists, peaking professionally in the early 2000s, when he won the US Open men’s doubles title with Leander Paes. The Czech accumulated 40 ATP titles, ultimately reaching a career-high in doubles at No. 5 in the world in 2007. Before realizing his full potential in doubles, Martin Damm rose through the ranks in singles, reaching a career high of No. 42 in 1997. Damm ultimately retired in 2011.

On top of that, Damm Jr. exhibited a promising junior career before entering the pro circuit. As a junior in 2021, he reached a career-high ITF junior ranking at No. 3. At 15, he beat a young Alcaraz in the quarterfinals of the Wimbledon boys’ singles event, before a tough loss in the semifinals. Known in junior tennis for his lefty game and wicked serve mixed with a strike-first, power-heavy game, Damm aims to take that aggression and firepower to the professional tour.

For Damm, qualifying for the main draw is only the beginning. He knows the competition field is strong, so he hopes to use every chance he can to adapt to the ATP main draw level. This year at Wimbledon, Damm made it to the second round, so his goal remains set not on a specific result, but on learning how to adapt.

title: Kangana Ranaut calls Cockroach Janta Party's Saurav Das ‘useless and unemployed’: At his age, I had 2 National Awards
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kangana Ranaut fired back at Saurav Das for his comments about her. What Kangana shared Taking to her Instagram Stories, Kangana reposted a video of Saurav speaking about her, and added a note. It read, “I googled this person and he is 28 years old. How he claims to be a student I have no clue! Yes I am in politics for past 2 years but I have been in public life for the last 20 years. At his age, I had 2 National Awards.”

Adding to this, Kangana accepted her past comments as an MP and added, “Yes as a new Parlamentarian I was overwhelmed with all the work because I am also a filmmaker + performing artist + producer + screen writer + entrepreneur. But someone like him who is totally useless and unemployed will never understand what it means to be in massive demand in all times at any age.”
Meanwhile, “Dear Saurav your issues are personal. You are not a student you are simply useless. Let's start with learning some skill. It's a good place to start,” she concluded.

Notably, In conversation with ANI, Saurav had shared, "Even members of her own party don't pay much heed to Kangana Ranaut or take her seriously, so why should we? I don't think anyone in Gen Z, Gen Alpha, or any younger generation takes her seriously or listens to what she says. She is a politician now. There were videos from when she visited her constituency in Himachal Pradesh where she remarked that she had expected the job to require very little work, only to realise that being a Member of Parliament involves a massive amount of labour. That speaks volumes about her own seriousness. Gen Z has done more for this country than her.”

As per the latest buzz, This was in response to what Kangana had shared about the Gen Z protests over the last few days. Kangana wrote, “Never in my life, I have seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing, the way they speak and the kind of language they are using. Never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once.”

In further updates, She added, “Ewwww, who is birthing and raising them? India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication; you call yourselves cockroaches and look/behave like them as well; there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox.”

On top of that, Her remarks came after Delhi Police directed multiple social media platforms to remove posts and videos containing offensive and abusive remarks against Modi. The posts were allegedly uploaded during the student protests at Jantar Mantar after the police crackdown during the July 20 Chalo Sansad march.

title: Dev Anand's son Suneil Anand passes away at 70 after suffering heart attack in London
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Suneil Anand, son of legendary star Dev Anand, passed away in London at the age of 70 following a heart attack, his family verified.
Adding to this, The news of his demise was verified by the family through a statement issued by his niece, Gina Narang, who requested privacy as they mourn the loss.

Meanwhile, Sharing the news, Gina Narang shared the family is grateful for the support they have received during this difficult time: "With heavy hearts, our family mourns the passing of Suneil Anand. We are comforted by the outpouring of love, prayers, and support, for which we are truly grateful. We kindly request privacy as we navigate this difficult time together."

Notably, Suneil Anand was the only son of iconic star and filmmaker Dev Anand and his wife Kalpana Kartik. Born into one of Hindi cinema's most celebrated movie families, Suneil made his acting debut with Anand Aur Anand (1984), a movie directed by his father.
As per the latest buzz, Suneil Anand's passing marks the end of another chapter in the Anand family's cinematic legacy. Further details regarding the last rites are awaited.

In further updates, The entire team at Bollywood Hungama extends its heartfelt condolences to Suneil Anand's family, friends and loved ones during this difficult time. May his soul rest in peace, and may those mourning his loss find strength and comfort in the memories they shared with him.

title: Dev Anand's son Suneil Anand dies at 70, family seeks privacy amid grief
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Legendary star Dev Anand 's son, Suneil Anand, has died. He was 70. His death was verified by his family to news agency PTI on Tuesday, July 28.
Adding to this, Suneil Anand has died at the age of 70. Dev Anand's son dies Anand's niece, Gina Narang, shared a statement on behalf of the family.

Meanwhile, "With heavy hearts, our family mourns the passing of Suneil Anand. We are comforted by the outpouring of love, prayers, and support, for which we are truly grateful. We kindly request privacy as we navigate this difficult time together," the statement read.
Notably, Suneil has acted in Anand aur Anand (1984), Car Thief (1986), Main Tere Liye (1988), and Master.
As per the latest buzz, His first directorial venture, Master, a martial arts movie, was rolled out in 2001.
In further updates, The family did not disclose the cause of death. He was the son of Dev Anand and Kalpana Kartik.

On top of that, Suneil decided to follow in his father’s footsteps after completing his degree in business administration from American University in Washington DC. He assisted Dev Anand on several of his directorials in the late 1970s and the early 1980s, Suneil was launched by his father in the latter’s 1984 directorial Anand Aur Anand.

Dev played the lead in the movie, casting himself opposite Raakhee and Smita Patil , while his son played the supporting role. Unfortunately, the movie tanked at the ticket-window. Then, Suneil got another shot with Sameer Malkan’s 1986 movie Car Thief, in which he played the lead role opposite Vijayta Pandit . Backed by Dev Anand’s production house Navketan Films, the movie also starred Rajendra Kumar and Asha Parekh. However. Alas, even that didn’t did not fare well at the ticket-window.

title: Shilpa Shetty breaks silence after reservation post goes viral: “I am shocked to see fake statements falsely attached to my name”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star has denied any connection to the widely shared message on caste-based reservation, urging social media users not to believe fabricated claims circulating online.

Adding to this, The widely shared post, which was widely shared online, read, “Don’t touch reservation. Let general category doctors treat only general category patients and let everyone else treat only patients from their own caste. Do this for a few years and people will start asking to end caste-based reservation themselves. You can't get skill through reservation.”

Meanwhile, As the post continued to circulate with her name attached to it, Shilpa Shetty took to social media to set the record straight and distance herself from the message. The star categorically denied authoring or endorsing the statement, describing it as fabricated. Addressing the issue, Shilpa wrote, “I am shocked to see fake statements on reservation falsely attached to my name. This is completely fabricated, malicious garbage. Do not fall for this fake news.”
Notably, I am shocked to see fake statements on reservation falsely attached to my name. This is completely fabricated, malicious garbage.
As per the latest buzz, — SHILPA SHETTY KUNDRA (@TheShilpaShetty) July 28, 2026

In further updates, With this statement, the star made it clear that the widely shared message did not originate from her and urged people not to believe or further circulate misinformation carrying her name. Shilpa's response has since been widely shared online, with many users appreciating her prompt clarification while urging others to verify information before forwarding or engaging with widely shared posts.

On top of that, The clarification comes at a time when misinformation and fabricated star statements continue to spread rapidly across social media platforms, often leading to confusion among users. Public figures have increasingly had to address such instances directly to prevent false narratives from gaining credibility.

For now, Shilpa Shetty has unequivocally shared that the reservation-related message circulating online has no connection to her. Her clarification puts to rest speculation surrounding the widely shared post and reiterates her appeal to the public not to fall for fabricated statements falsely attributed to her.

title: Kangana Ranaut defends those beating up students 'on the roads': Jab bolte ho toh sunna bhi padega
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has criticised the Cockroach Janta Party protests, which were predominantly attended and led by the students. She has defended those beating the protestors among the students, saying that they must know every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

Adding to this, Kangana took to her Instagram Stories and wrote: “Protestors who are getting beaten and abused on the roads by common people because of their filthy and abusive reels. They must understand that jab bolte ho toh sunna bhi padega. Agar tum public property damage karte ho toh woh public bhi tumko damage karegi. Agar tumko desh aur leadership se problem hai aur tumne publicly khoob gandi gandi gaaliyan di toh ab unki suno jo iss desh se pyaar karte hain aur iss sarkar ko vote ki power se leke aayein hain. Kyuki bolne ka haq unko bhi hain. Ab rone wali koi baat nahi. Every action has equal and opposite reaction agar padai karke cause and effect samajh nahi aya hai toh aab aa jayega. Aur bahut acche se samjh aayega.”

Meanwhile, It translates to: “You say a lot and so shall listen now. If you damage public property, then the public will damage you too. If you have a problem with the country and the leadership and abuse them badly then now listen the same from the ones who love the country and have voted for this government. They also have the power to say. Nothing to cry about. Now you will understand what it means that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.”

Notably, On Monday, Kangana had shared that the protests are in stark difference with the values and sophistication that India stands for. She shared, “Never in my life, I have seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing, the way they speak and the kind of language they are using. Never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once.”

As per the latest buzz, She added, “Ewwww, who is birthing and raising them? India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication; you call yourselves cockroaches and look/behave like them as well; there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox.”

In further updates, The Gen Z protests sparked a widely shared trend on Instagram with many students documenting their experience on the platform. From making fit checks before attending the protests to making memes like “Dilli Police se maar khane jaa raha hu (Going to get a beating from the Delhi Police),” the Gen Z protestors laughed and danced at the protest site as the protest itself became content. Reels also showed protesters running from police barricades set to the iconic Subway Surfers soundtrack.

On top of that, The sprawling sit-in in Delhi’s historic Jantar Mantar was called off hours after the resignation was revealed by the minister on X with leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) saying the government had accepted two other demands. Celebrations erupted soon after as young men and women – many of them Gen Z -- waved the tricolour, climbed barricades and broke into impromptu jigs as makeshift loudspeakers belted out Bollywood favourites.

title: Sunny Deol tears up as Rajkumar Santoshi recalls Dharmendra’s reaction to Batwara 1947: ‘Bola tha picture chalegi’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Aamir Khan Productions’ Batwara 1947 trailer was unveiled on Tuesday in the presence of the movie's cast and crew. It also left everyone emotional as director Rajkumar Santoshi narrated late Dharmendra’s bonding with the movie. Sunny Deol , Shabana Azmi, Karan Deol and Abhimanyu Singh were in attendance at the launch of the trailer. The movie's story revolves around the chaos and mess caused during the partition of 1947, which saw many families torn apart in the madness of communal riots.

Adding to this, Sunny Deol gets emotional as Rajkumar Santoshi recalls Dharmendra’s reaction to Batwara 1947. Sunny Deol gets emotional over Dharmendra’s connection with the movie The trailer launch became particularly moving when Rajkumar spoke about Dharmendra , who had watched the movie before his death. Sunny was visibly emotional, wiping away tears as the filmmaker recalled how the veteran star reacted when he was shown the movie.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Addressing the press in Hindi, Rajkumar shared, “Dharam ji ki blessing bahut hai iss movie ke andar. Narration suna tha and he was very emotional. Aankh mein aansu aa gaye, bahut aashirwad diya aur Dharam ji ki mere khyaal se last movie joh unhone dekhi woh bhi Batwara hai. Tabhi unhone bola tha ki picture bahut chalegi bahut achcha kaam kiya aap logon ne unka aashirwad hai toh I am grateful and I thank Dharam ji today here."

Notably, (Translation: This movie carries Dharam-ji's abundant blessings. When he heard the narration, he was deeply moved—he was even brought to tears—and he offered his heartfelt blessings. In fact, I believe Batwara was the last movie of mine that he watched; even back then, he predicted it would be a huge success and lauded the excellent work we had done. I am truly grateful for his blessings and wish to express my thanks to Dharam-ji here today.)

As per the latest buzz, Shabana Azmi also got emotional and opened up about one of the most difficult moments she had to movie for Batwara 1947. The veteran star plays a character who is subjected to violence and humiliation, with a scene in the trailer showing her being dragged by the antagonist as her kurta is torn.

In further updates, “There is a scene in the movie which, personally, as a human being, made me feel very humiliated and very stripped of any dignity. You see a glimpse of it in the trailer, where the villain drags me and tears my kurta. At that moment, I don't think I have ever felt so vulnerable and exposed as I did as a human being,” she shared.

On top of that, View this post on Instagram Shabana gets emotional while talking about Sunny Deol The star also spoke about another interesting incident involving Sunny and his family. Shabana shared that her last show was the theatre production of Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani with Dharmendra, and she will be back on stage, doing a play with Sunny and Karan Deol.

“My last movie to rollout in theatres was with Dharam ji, and now my next movie is with Sunny and Karan. Now I can work with Abhay too. You all should ask Bobby to get ready as well,” she joked, drawing laughter from the audience.

title: Kangana Ranaut calls Gen Z “Generation Gutter” days after NEET protest, questions their upbringing: “So jarring and crass all at once”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Kangana Ranaut sparked row after calling Gen Z protesters "Generation Gutter" and criticising their language, conduct and social media posts.
Adding to this, The star described the protesters' content as "puke-inducing" and questioned their upbringing, while also targeting a section of women who participated in the demonstrations.

Meanwhile, Sharing her views on social media, Kangana shared she was disturbed by the language and behaviour seen in videos from the protests: "Never in my life have I seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing. The way they speak and the kind of language they are using... never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once."
Notably, She further questioned the upbringing of the protesters, writing: "Ewww, who is birthing and raising them?"

As per the latest buzz, Referring to protesters who had described themselves as "cockroaches," Kangana wrote: "India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication. You call yourself cockroaches and look/behave like them as well. There is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels. I need some healing, digital detox."

In further updates, The star also made comments about women who participated in the protests, referring to them as "so-called westernised Indian women." She alleged that they "proudly flaunt their freedom to have drugs, drinks and shamelessly live off their parents' earnings."

On top of that, Kangana further wrote: "I call them Generation Gutter. Some of them have nothing to offer to the system. They are not good at studies. They are so ugly and corrupt that they can't even be homemakers."

This is not the first time Kangana has spoken about the ongoing student protests. In earlier social media posts, she questioned the methods adopted by the protesters and criticised attempts to pressure the government through street demonstrations.

title: Batwara 1947 trailer: Sunny Deol will do anything to protect Shabana Azmi in film on Hindu-Muslim ties. Watch
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The official trailer of Sunny Deol 's highly anticipated Batwara 1947 is here. Set against the backdrop of the 1947 Partition, the movie tells the tale of a Muslim family in Lahore who come face-to-face with a Hindu woman refusing to leave her ancestral home.

Adding to this, Batwara 1947 trailer: Sunny Deol in a still from the movie. About the trailer The trailer begins with the good news of India getting its independence after years of struggle. Sunny Deol is then shocked to see how lives are irrevocably altered as violence, fear and forced migration tear apart communities that once lived side by side. He and his family, including wife Preity Zinta and son Karan Deol shift to Pakistan where they are alloted a new house. Ali Fazal welcomes them. But to their surprise, they find that an old Hindu woman ( Shabana Azmi ) is living there upstairs, and refuses to leave the house. She even performs puja in a small temple in her room, which angers many in the community.

Meanwhile, As tension arises with many forcing her to get out of the home, Sunny becomes a shield to keep her safe and protect his own family. When he is told why he is so desperate to save a Hindu woman, Sunny fires back: “Hindu aurat? Woh Maa hai Maa! Maa ko Hindu-Muslim mein naa baatiye. Maa apne aap mein ek mazhab hai. Har insaan ka pehla mazhab Maa hai. Har insaan ke mooh se nikla pehla labz Maa hai (Hindu woman? She is a mother. Do not label her with Hindu- Muslim. Our first religion is mother! The first word that we speak is mother).”

Notably, Batwara 1947 marks Preity's return to acting after over half a decade. The music for the movie has been composed by AR Rahman , with lyrics by Javed Akhtar. The movie has been cleared by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) without any cuts. Sunny took to his Instagram Stories to confirm the same on Monday.

As per the latest buzz, He wrote, “We're delighted that Batwara 1947 has been cleared by the CBFC without a single cut and awarded an A certificate. A movie about humanity and love. Watch it in theatres from this Partition Day, 14th August.” Batwara 1947 marks the reunion of 90's hit star-director combo-- Sunny Deol and Raj Kumar Santoshi. The pair has given iconic hits like Ghatak , Ghayal and Damini and Sunny believes the audience have been waiting for them to collaborate again.
In further updates, Batwara 1947 releases in theatres on August 14.

On top of that, Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and movie festivals. He has a keen interest in writing about South Asian independent films and has covered several movie festivals, including Sundance and CPH: Docx. He also brings a sharp perspective to the monthly column called The Fault in Our Stars, where he writes about a recent movie/series and what stops the ‘good’ from becoming ‘great’. A gold medalist from Banaras Hindu University, Santanu completed his postgraduate studies in English from Jadavpur University. He is also a Rotten Tomatoes-certified movie critic. When not watching films or in conversation with celebrities, Santanu can be found reading a book. Some of his favourite films are Aparajito, Ponyo and The Double Life of Veronique. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own. Santanu continues to write passionately about films and star culture. He brings a relatable, as well as critically informed, lens to entertainment and culture for a wide audience. Find him on LinkedIn: santanudasfilm Instagram: @santupecha Read More

body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Comedian Samay Raina 's show, India's Got Latent Season 2 , kicked off with Alia Bhatt and Sharvari as its first guests. The two appeared on the show to promote their movie, Alpha . However, in the latest episode of India's Got Latent, Samay took a sly dig at Alpha's box-office performance.

Adding to this, Samay Raina says Alia Bhatt and Sharvari's Alpha didn't work in theatres. Samay Raina takes a dig at Alpha The latest members-only episode featured Raghav Juyal and Niharika NM on the panel, who appeared to promote their movie, Bhai Tera Star Hai. While Raghav was talking about the movie, Samay pointed out that it was the second time he had repeated its title and quipped, "kitni baar khudh hi btaana padega. Kaisa star hai tu? (How many times will you have to tell people about your own movie? What kind of star are you?)"
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bollywood Netra (@bollywoodnetra)

Notably, In response, Raghav shared, "Alia Bhatt ne bhi khudh hi btaya tha (Alia Bhatt also promoted her own movie)." Samay then replied, "Uski bhi nahi chali fir (That didn't work for her movie either)."

As per the latest buzz, Samay had also booked an entire theatre to watch Alpha and distributed tickets to followers. Later, after the screening ended, he video-called Alia and told her that the audience had enjoyed the movie.

In further updates, Alpha underperformed at the ticket-window, collecting ₹ 98.83 crore rupees worldwide and ₹ 58.62 crore rupees in India. Helmed by Aditya Rawal, Alpha is the YRF Spy Universe's first female-led movie. It stars Alia Bhatt, Sharvari, Anil Kapoor and Bobby Deol in lead roles. The movie follows two elite agents on a high-stakes mission involving national security, blending large-scale action sequences with espionage.

On top of that, The movie opened to mixed-to-negative reviews from both critics and audiences. It also features a cameo by Hrithik Roshan, which received a mixed response. While some viewers called it the best part of the movie, others felt it was unnecessary. Alia and Sharvari's performances also received criticism. Alpha is the seventh instalment in the YRF Spy Universe after Ek Tha Tiger, Tiger Zinda Hai, War, Pathaan, Tiger 3 and War 2. Apart from Alpha, the franchise has enjoyed a successful run at the ticket-window.

India's Got Latent became embroiled in row after Ranveer Allahbadia's remarks about parents and sex sparked widespread backlash on social media. As a result, Samay was forced to delete all the episodes from YouTube. In 2026, he revealed Season 2 of the show during his stand-up comedy special, Still Alive, leaving followers excited. The new season now streams on both YouTube and Netflix.

title: Salman Khan plans multi-phase relief drive for Assam flood victims: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Salman Khan has as per reports launched a multi-phase relief drive through Being Human and his Assam fan club to support families affected by the state's floods.
Adding to this, According to a Mid-Day report, Khan has been overseeing the relief efforts while continuing to shoot for director Vamshi Paidipally's soon-to-release movie in Mumbai.

Meanwhile, A source close to the star told mid-day that Salman personally reached out to the Salman Khan Fan Club in Assam to plan the relief work: "He connected with the Salman Khan Fan Club [SKFC] Assam and planned a phased process to aid the affected."
Notably, As part of the first phase, Being Human has partnered with SKFC Assam to distribute ready-to-eat food packets in Sivasagar, with supplies being transported from Guwahati.

As per the latest buzz, According to the source, each packet contains biscuits, jaggery, poha, puffed rice, bread, cheese and jam to help families sustain themselves during the ongoing crisis: "Each packet consists of biscuits, jaggery, poha, puffed rice, bread, cheese, and jam. Salman’s priority is to make sure families have enough food to last for at least three days until the situation improves."
In further updates, Apart from food, the relief drive also includes the distribution of sanitary pads, mosquito coils, drinking water and water purification tablets.

On top of that, The report further states that the initiative will continue in multiple phases. The second phase, expected to begin next week, will focus on distributing ration kits and medicines to affected families.
In the final phase, Being Human is expected to assist in rebuilding schools and hospitals that have suffered extensive damage in the floods.

title: Rekha to receive excellence in cinema award at IFFM
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
New Delhi, Veteran Hindi cinema star Rekha will attend the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne as guest of honour where she will be presented with the prestigious excellence in cinema award.

Adding to this, Rekha to receive excellence in cinema award at IFFM The festival will screen "Umrao Jaan" to celebrate Rekha's unparalleled body of work and extraordinary contribution to Indian cinema that spans across movies such as "Silsila", "Khoobsurat", "Ijaazat", "Ghar", "Khoon Bhari Maang", "Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi" and Koi... Mil Gaya".
Meanwhile, Directed by Muzaffar Ali, "Umrao Jaan" is one of the most defining films in Rekha's career and celebrated 45 years of its rollout this year.

Notably, "'Umrao Jaan' has never left me. She lives in my memories, in my silences, and in the hearts of those who have embraced her with a lot of love over the years. To revisit that journey and see the movie being celebrated on a global stage is both humbling and moving," Rekha, 71, shared in a note.

As per the latest buzz, "Cinema has been my life's greatest blessing, and to be honoured with the Excellence in Cinema Award at IFFM 2026 is special. I accept this honour with immense gratitude, not only as a recognition of my own journey, but also as a tribute to the filmmakers, writers, musicians and countless collaborators who have enriched my life and shaped my work."
In further updates, The star will also hoist the Indian flag in Melbourne on August 15 alongside members of the Indian diaspora, Australian dignitaries, filmmakers, artists, and cinema lovers.

On top of that, The festival's annual flag-hoisting ceremony has previously been led by some of Indian cinema's most iconic personalities, including late Rishi Kapoor, Aamir Khan, Shabana Azmi, Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan, Ramcharan and filmmaker Karan Johar.

"There are very few artists whose presence transcends cinema and becomes part of a nation's cultural consciousness. Rekha ji is one such timeless icon. Her extraordinary body of work, her grace, and the unparalleled legacy she has built over decades have inspired audiences not only in India but across the world. It is an immense privilege for the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne to welcome her as our Guest of Honour this year," Mitu Bhowmick Lange, Founder and Festival Director of the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne, shared.
